messages:
emily: Escalating a customer report — Acme sees intermittent 502s + connection resets when calling our streaming generate endpoint. Customer says it started yesterday after a large batch job. Logs attached.

acme_sre: Hey team — we get a 502 about 1 in 20 streams. It usually fails after ~12s into the stream. Non-retryable from our SDK perspective. Example curl we used:
```bash
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<really long prompt>"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate/stream
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway

We see socket resets on our side: "unexpected EOF". No spikes in client CPU. Happening across regions (us-west & eu).

emily: Thanks. I've attached the customer-provided request_id: req_0a12b3c4. Repro steps: customer sends many small chunks (their app streams input as the user types). They say switching to a single POST body reduced failures.

raj: Triage notes from edge logs for req_0a12b3c4: upstream reported "connection reset by peer (errno=104)" in proxy. Correlated timestamp shows repeated "h2_window_exhausted" warnings on the edge. Also seeing rate-limiter warnings: "quota-check timeout to billing (2005ms)" around same timeframe.

tara: Interesting — we haven't seen billing timeouts produce connection resets before. Hypothesis: small-chunk streaming + h2 window pressure + delayed quota check creates backpressure so the edge decides to terminate the upstream connection.

edge-bot: edge-proxy(egress)-node-12: rotated connection for stream req_0a12b3c4: reason=upstream_reset, details=RST_STREAM code=2, h2_window=0

raj: Repro attempt from my laptop using the customer's chunked pattern (script streams 1kb chunks every 50ms). After ~10-15s I reproduced a 502 with proxy log: "outbound socket closed while upstream still sending". Kernel netstat on the node shows high SYN_RECV backlog briefly.

emily: Customer-facing status update drafted: "We're investigating intermittent 502s for streaming requests when clients use many small chunked writes. Temporary mitigation: if possible, send the full payload in one request or buffer client-side to coalesce chunks. We're rolling a fix to reduce edge h2 window pressure." Want to push?

tara: Quick mitigation we can do now (low risk): tune edge h2 initial window size and increase chunk buffer threshold on node-12 and node-15. That should reduce RST_STREAM events while we track the billing-check interplay. I'll prepare a config rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout started: edge-config-v2026.03.17-window-tuning -> nodes [12,15] (canary=1/2)

raj: Also adding a short circuit for quota-checks during streaming session init: if billing backend doesn't reply within 1s, proceed with a conservative rate limit token and attach post-facto billing audit. This avoids blocking the edge handshake. Need Product signoff but can be toggled as a feature flag.

tara: For root cause followup: collect full tcpdump for a repro run + proxy frame traces (h2 frames) and billing service p95 around timestamps. I'll open a dedicated bug with reproducer script.

emily: Notes for customer comms:
- Ask them to try non-chunked POST to confirm mitigation.
- If they must stream, suggest increasing client-side chunk size to ~8-16KB.
- We'll monitor req_0a12b3c4 and follow up in 2 hours or sooner.

acme_sre: Trying a single-body POST now. Will report in 15m. Thanks for the quick triage.

raj: Follow-up: Canary nodes showed a ~70% reduction in 502s for synthetic repro. Rolling to remainder after 15m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: rollout completed: edge-config-v2026.03.17-window-tuning -> nodes [12,15,16,17,18] status=success

emily: Customer update (sent): "We deployed a temporary edge tuning that reduces the likelihood of connection resets for chunked streams. If you can, please try the single-body POST or increase chunk size. We'll continue to analyze and implement a durable fix." :thumbsup:

acme_sre: We tested single-body POST — no 502s in 200 requests. Streaming test with 1KB chunks still fails ~4%. Streaming with 16KB chunks looks stable.

tara: Great repro data. Action items:
- eng-runtime: implement a more tolerant h2 window reclamation path (INVEST).
- eng-infra: add graceful fallback for quota checks during stream init (feature flag).
- support: follow up w/ customer in 24h to confirm stability.

raj: I'll attach tcpdump and proxy trace to the bug. Link: https://internal.redwood/bugs/RED-5123

emily: Closing loop in thread — keeping open until we confirm customer stable for 24h. Thanks team.
